title.narrative: Empowering Yemeni Women in Renewable Energy Projects

description.narrative: 1) Establish small businesses for women in basic solar-based home appliances to address energy gaps. 2) Provide vulnerable and displaced households with alternative solar-based energy sources for basic lighting and home cooking appliances manufactured by women’s businesses.

375 women benefited from vocational and commercial training. - 375 small projects were established to produce and market basic solar-powered household appliances (lanterns, stoves, and traditional ovens). - Development of 3 training manuals on the installation of solar energy devices. - Provision and distribution of 3,000 solar lanterns. - Provision and distribution of 9,000 solar-powered cooking appliances. - Provision and distribution of 9,000 traditional solar-powered ovens (tanour).

Promoting innovative solutions to spread the application and use of solar energy and enhancing women’s participation in small solar businesses. The project works to promote the spread of renewable energy applications and cover the needs of basic household activities and lighting, and to engage vulnerable women in establishing businesses that meet the energy use needs of vulnerable communities and energy markets.
